_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja IllusionTheatre/Teatr Iluzji (134 terminy, ~35 mikroscen) - MIEJSCE ZBRODNI, gdzie zginal Mortuga. Zawiera rekonstrukcje zwlok (outline), krew, Kociol, mechanike Zelaznego Dzwonu z zagadka obracanej rury/plakatu, oraz szafke z lalka wygladajaca jak Symmetry (mechanizm iluzji teatralnej).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: So, it's a lifesize doll, that looks like Symmetry?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.pl: Więc to lalka naturalnej wielkości, która wygląda jak Symmetry?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: But I think there's more to it than that.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.pl: Ale myślę, że to coś więcej.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: There's a wooden panel on the wall here...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.pl: Jest tu na ścianie drewniany panel...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: Can you see anything through that little hole?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.pl: Widzisz coś przez ten mały otwór?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: This wooden panel - [i]surely[/i] there's something behind it?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.pl: Ten drewniany panel - [i]na pewno[/i] jest za nim coś?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: It's a little set of tiles.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.en: Right, let's get this thing open-
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cabine.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cloth/.en: There's a cloth hanging up on the wall.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Cloth/.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DemoLo.en: ...because this is the last room in the demo.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DemoLo.pl: ...bo to ostatni pokój w wersji demo.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DemoLo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.en: There's a drain along the back of the room.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.pl: Wzdłuż tylnej ściany pokoju jest odpływ.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.en:
It's actually not a drain.
Not right now - it's closed up.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.pl:
To właściwie nie jest odpływ.
Nie teraz - jest zamknięty.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainC.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.en: Hey, it's open - wasn't it closed before?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.pl: Hej, jest otwarty - czy nie był wcześniej zamknięty?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.en: Yeah, we pulled that switch down in the bilge, remember?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.pl: Tak, pociągnęliśmy tamten przełącznik w zęzie, pamiętasz?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_DrainO.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_LetsCo.en: I do, but - let's finish the checklist first.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_LetsCo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_LetsCo.en: You don't wanna take another look in here?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_LetsCo.pl: Nie chcesz jeszcze raz się tu rozejrzeć?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_LetsCo.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Lookfo.en: It's about time we went to speak with everyone else...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Lookfo.pl: Najwyższy czas, żebyśmy poszli porozmawiać z resztą...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Lookfo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.en: I'm guessing Mortuga dropped this when he died.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.pl: Zgaduję, że Mortuga to upuścił, kiedy umierał.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.en: There's a little broken bottle on the floor.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.pl: Na podłodze leży mała rozbita buteleczka.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_MoonVi.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.en: I think it's supposed to be a poster...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.en: Someone's taped a drawing to the wall.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.en: Although it's upside-down for some reason....?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.pl: Chociaż z jakiegoś powodu jest do góry nogami....?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Poster.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_ReadyT.en: Well, here we are. One last time.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_ReadyT.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_ReadyT.en: There must be some way get the Iron Bell to lower onto the Cauldron...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_ReadyT.pl: Musi być jakiś sposób, żeby opuścić Żelazny Dzwon na Kocioł...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_ReadyT.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Window.en: ...why did you phrase it like that?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Window.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Window.en: It looks out into the endless dark void of the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Window.pl: Wychodzi na niekończącą się, mroczną pustkę oceanu.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_Window.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.en: Someone's hung up a banner with the words [i]Illusion Theatre[/i] painted on it.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.pl: Ktoś powiesił baner z namalowanymi słowami [i]Teatr Iluzji[/i].
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.en: You know, I think this room's had some kind of rebranding.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.pl: Wiesz, myślę, że ten pokój przeszedł jakiś rebranding.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.en:
Rebranding from what?
What was it before?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.pl:
Rebranding z czego?
Czym był wcześniej?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.en: A small room like this wouldn't normally have a name at all.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.pl: Taki mały pokój zwykle w ogóle nie miałby nazwy.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.pl: Zastanawiam się, na czym polega ta iluzja...?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_banner.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bell L.en: What d'you know, it fits perfectly.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bell L.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.en: So this is the Illusion Theatre?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.en: It's very small for a theatre...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.pl: Jest bardzo mały jak na teatr...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.en: It's basically just the end of a corridor - separated from the rest of the corridor by... a door.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.pl: To w zasadzie tylko koniec korytarza - oddzielony od reszty korytarza przez... drzwi.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg 1/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.en: There [i]must[/i] be a way to lower the Iron Bell into this room...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.pl: [i]Musi[/i] być jakiś sposób, żeby opuścić Żelazny Dzwon do tego pokoju...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.en: There [i]must[/i] be a way to lower the Iron Bell into this room...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.pl: [i]Musi[/i] być jakiś sposób, żeby opuścić Żelazny Dzwon do tego pokoju...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.en: I think we should [i]probably[/i] shut the Cauldron first.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.pl: Myślę, że [i]chyba[/i] powinniśmy najpierw zamknąć Kocioł.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_bg Mus.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.en: A trail of blood. Looks like it came from the wound in Mortuga's neck.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.pl: Ślad krwi. Wygląda, jakby pochodziła z rany na szyi Mortugi.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.en: It runs straight down the room towards the back of the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.pl: Biegnie prosto przez pokój w stronę tyłu łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.en: It pools out first, [h]then[/h] changes its mind.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.pl: Najpierw się rozlewa, a [h]potem[/h] zmienia zdanie.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_blood/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.en: Not quite what I was expecting...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.pl: Nie do końca to, czego się spodziewałem...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.en: The case file said it had never been unlocked before...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.pl: W aktach sprawy było napisane, że nigdy wcześniej nie był odblokowany...
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.en: Let's leave it shut for now.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_cauldr.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.en: Someone's hung up a curtain here.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.en: It's tied to the wall right now, but looks like it can be drawn across the middle of the room.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.pl: Teraz jest przywiązana do ściany, ale wygląda na to, że można ją rozciągnąć przez środek pokoju.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.en: Finally something to justify the name of the room.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.pl: Wreszcie coś, co uzasadnia nazwę tego pokoju.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_curtai.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.en:
It's a heavy bulkhead door.
Seems like you lock it by turning that big wheel.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.pl:
To ciężkie drzwi grodziowe.
Wygląda na to, że zamyka się je, obracając to wielkie koło.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.en: If you were strong enough, maybe.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.en: There's actually a wheel on [h]both[/h] sides of the door.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.pl: Właściwie koło jest po [h]obu[/h] stronach drzwi.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.en: So I could lock it or unlock it from either side?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.pl: Więc mogłabym je zamknąć albo otworzyć z dowolnej strony?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_door/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.en: So... this is where Magnus Mortuga died.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.pl: Więc... tu właśnie zginął Magnus Mortuga.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.en:
It's just like the case file said.
He landed on his back, with the cauldron at his feet.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.pl:
Dokładnie tak, jak było w aktach sprawy.
Upadł na plecy, z kotłem u stóp.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.en:
Yeah.
You can see that's where the blood came from.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.pl:
Tak.
Widać, że stąd wzięła się krew.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.en: He was killed by getting cut across the neck, right?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.pl: Zginął od cięcia w szyję, prawda?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.en:
But there's no weapon?
No knife or anything?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.pl:
Ale nie ma żadnej broni?
Żadnego noża czy czegoś?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_outlin.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: The pipe looks a little loose... d'you think it's supposed to [i]move?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.pl: Ta rura wygląda na trochę luźną... myślisz, że powinna się [i]ruszać?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: Hang on - let's shut the cauldron first, just in case.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.pl: Czekaj - zamknijmy najpierw kocioł, na wszelki wypadek.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: ...it's taped to a pipe on the wall.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: The pipe looks a little loose... d'you think it's supposed to [i]move?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.pl: Ta rura wygląda na trochę luźną... myślisz, że powinna się [i]ruszać?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: ...it's taped to a pipe on the wall.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en: So it's a winch handle disguised as a pipe?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.pl: Więc to korba wciągarki zamaskowana jako rura?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.en:
That explains why the poster was [i]upside-down!
[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.pl:
To wyjaśnia, czemu plakat był [i]do góry nogami!
[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_poster.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.en: Where else have we seen a stool like this...?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.en: Doesn't it look familiar to you?
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.en: Sally. It's a standard wooden stool, I don't-
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.pl: Sally. To zwyczajny drewniany stołek, ja nie-
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.en: It looks [i]exactly[/i] like the bar stools in the Stonetop Inn.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.pl: Wygląda [i]dokładnie[/i] jak barowe stołki w Gospodzie Stonetop.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.en: It looks [i]exactly[/i] like the bar stools in the Stonetop Inn.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.pl: Wygląda [i]dokładnie[/i] jak barowe stołki w Gospodzie Stonetop.
Examine/Exam_Area_IllusionTheatre_stool.speaker: Sally
